rules: IDs and operation meanings are frozen for this version; unknown versions/IDs fail closed.
Outside quoted data, source contains only ASCII symbols, decimal digits and optional ASCII whitespace.
A separator is required between adjacent numeric tokens and between false minus and a following nonnegative integer.
No leading zeros, negative zero, floats, comments, imports, eval, shell, filesystem or network.
Slots are function-scoped; existing VM declaration, assignment and finite-loop rules apply.
Canonical conversion renames local/function identifiers; it preserves program semantics, not original symbol names, comments or source bytes.
Source parsing is a bounded trusted C/Python frontend; code generation remains the existing RB-written compiler.
A dictionary is public language semantics, not a key or access grant. Shared dictionary setup costs must be counted on a cold receiver.
Numeric runs are exact list literals, not unchecked execution or lossy rounding. Counts, generated nodes, depth and expanded-source limits are checked.

tokens.!1: version header, followed by whitespace and numeric entry ID
tokens.\"...\": UTF-8 text using strict JSON string escapes
tokens.#start,delta,second,count: bounded exact arithmetic/quadratic integer-list literal; int64 checked at every step, count0..4096
tokens.:N(P...){}: function N, numeric parameter slots and body
primitive ID N with dictionary-fixed arity
